Definition: of uncertain origin; Lebbæus, a Christian:--Lebbæus.
BiblicalUsage: Lebbaîos is the name of Lebbæus, the apostle also called Thaddaeus. In Matthew 10:3, "and Lebbaeus".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lebbaeus matters because he is the apostle with two names — Matthew's list calls him Lebbaeus, and the same man is Thaddaeus elsewhere. I hold that God knows His servants by every name they carry.
